messages:
Marcos: FYI seeing a batch of GPU nodes in eu-west-1 get stuck during boot — failing at 'attach keystore' with KMS STS errors. Autoscaler retries but capacity is degraded (~30m). Anyone touching keystore/KMS policies or egress rules?
Sara: I noticed a firewall/egress change rolled late last night to tighten outbound from infra subnets. Could that block privatelink to KMS? @Jin?
Jin: I did push an NACL tweak to reduce blast radius for a deploy, but it should've only matched build subnets. Let me check the rule CIDR and the TGW route propagation — will report in 5.
Carla: VPC flow logs -> node 10.20.34.0/24 to kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com (34.12.56.78) showing TCP RST and then AccessDenied from KMS. Looks like traffic is getting to the endpoint but the principal is failing STS. Could be a key policy/role mismatch.
Marcos: Hmm, ops side is ambiguous (network vs. KMS auth). Current impact: autoscaler spawns keep timing out, fallback to other regions causing brief cost spike and request queuing. Need a one‑button mitigation.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-421 "kms-provisioning-fail-eu" — paging oncall.
Sara: Temporary mitigation plan: 1) open egress to KMS endpoint from node-subnet 2) attach existing keystore role to the instance profile in eu-west-1 3) re-run provisioning. Testing step 1 now. Command: `aws ec2 modify-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0abc --ingress false --rule-number 200`
Jin: If step 1 works I'll rollback my NACL change. If it's a key policy we should not widen permanently. I'll also check the KMS key policy and trust for the infra role.
Carla: Note: enabling broader KMS access will increase KMS API traffic and CloudTrail volume — rough estimate +$150–250/day while mitigated. Flagging for finance and infra costs.
Marcos: Proceed with the minimal change to restore capacity. Sara, keep the change scoped to node-subnet and tag with `incident=INC-2026-421`. Jin, follow up with a PR to tighten the policy with the exact allowed principals.
Sara: Done — opened change with `change/INC-2026-421` and patch applied to node-subnet egress. Provisioning started and nodes are now attaching keystore again. :thumbsup:
Jin: Reverting my NACL tweak and starting an audit of all recent egress rules. Will create a tracking ticket for KMS key policy review.
Carla: Logged the cost impact on the incident, added required approvers. We should include this in the postmortem.
Marcos: Good work. Action items: Jin -> KMS policy PR; Sara -> runbook update + revert when safe; Carla -> cost/alert thresholds on KMS audit logs. Close oncall handover in #eng-sre.
ops-bot: Update: INC-2026-421 status -> mitigated (2026-04-18T21:10:10Z).
